_about: Gold query set. 5 per book, sharpness 1 (very unique to the book) -> 5 (generic archetype). Each entry simulates a distilled LLM query frame: a general-register summary (present tense, no proper names, feeling words only in descriptors) plus the decomposed frame (subject/verb/object/setting) and a guessed descriptor vibe. Used to probe retrieval precision falloff as a query gets more general.
